text:
sana_sales: Quick sync — FinLedger POC asking for commit guidance. They expect mixed traffic: steady 150 RPS embedding/retreival, spikes to ~1200 RPS during batch runs. They want reserved GPUs + autoscale. What's our recommended commit size and fallback plan? :thinking:

ryan_se: Do we have exact token distribution? embeddings vs chat/generation will change GPU throughput a lot.

sana_sales: Good Q — rough split: 60% embeddings (short vectors), 30% chat completions (avg 120 tokens), 10% long-batch reranks. Average latency SLO = 300ms p95 for chat, embeddings < 100ms.

maria_sre: Security asks: they require VPC peering + KMS integration and audit logs. Private deployment preferred if commit > monthly threshold. Also they want AZ failover.

ben_eng: For that mix I'd recommend reserved pool equivalent to 6x A100-80GB (or quantized 8x if they accept FP8/INT8 quality). Autoscale policy: keep reserved as steady baseline, allow burst credits up to 12 GPUs in AZ-limited bursts, cross-AZ fallback if capacity needed.

elaine_cs: Pricing note: reserved 6 GPUs monthly vs pay-as-you-go diff is ~35% cheaper at their projected usage. Burst credits charged at an elevated rate — call out in contract.

ryan_se: Thumbs-up on reserve baseline. Also propose adaptive batching for embeddings to reduce token cost during steady traffic. We'll enable prefix caching for chat to hit latency SLO without full compute.

ben_eng: Example autoscale snippet (for ops to review):
```json
{
  "min_gpus": 6,
  "max_gpus": 12,
  "scale_policy": "cpu_token_utilization",
  "target_p95_latency_ms": 300,
  "burst_credit_pool": "enabled",
  "cross_az_fallback": true
}
```

maria_sre: Also need to confirm data residency for embeddings and ensure envelope encryption in transit+at-rest. I'll ping infra for KMS key policy template.

elaine_cs: From commercial: include clause that we honor prewarm windows (they want guaranteed preheat for daily 10m spikes). That affects reserved sizing.

sana_sales: Action items: (1) eng to confirm quantized model perf delta on their prompts (ben) (2) SRE to draft VPC/KMS checklist (maria) (3) rev pricing with burst tiers and prewarm SLA (elaine). Can we have a short calc of expected throughput per GPU so I can share with customer?

ben_eng: Quick calc: with quantized v2 model approx: embeddings ~2200 qps per GPU, chat (120 tokens avg) ~35-45 rps per GPU depending on batch tuning. So 6 GPUs -> ~13k embeddings steady or ~210 rps chat. Spikes to 1200 chat RPS require ~28 GPUs raw but with batching + prefix cache we can cut to ~10-12 GPUs (hence our burst cap).

ryan_se: Will prepare a 1-pager with cost/latency tradeoffs (quantized vs fp16) and a suggested commit of 6 reserved + burst up to 12 with cross-AZ fallback.

maria_sre: I'll add the security questionnaire pointers and note Private deployment trigger at commit >= 100k USD/month.

elaine_cs: I'll price the 6-reserve + burst schedule and add prewarm SLA language; will flag optics for legal.

ops-bot: Scheduled: prewarm test run on staging tomorrow 10:00 UTC (reminder will go out). :rocket:

sana_sales: Great — let's regroup after the prewarm test. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
